params.prompt: Keyframe 1 of a 15-second wine commercial, vertical 9:16, beats 1 and 2, lights on. The first reference image defines the look only: stylized 3D animation with graphic comic-book shading, halftone dots in the shadows, bold ink edge lines, subtle misregistered colour fringes, neon magenta and cyan rim lights over deep night blues, cinematic depth of field; never copy its layout or composition. The bottle label stays accurate and readable. SCENE: late evening in a modern Tokyo apartment: walnut dining table for two, floor-to-ceiling window at camera-left with the skyline and a full moon, warm washi pendant lit over the table, kitchen doorway at camera-right. On the table: two plates with fish leftovers, chopsticks on rests, a bowl of edamame. SUBJECT: Aya <<<65a0c653-c433-4c10-a435-a4ce5504f0a2>>> and Ren <<<c800522c-a722-4f47-bb45-2f32899d7e45>>> sit facing each other, laughing over the last glass of red wine. In the near foreground the short-tailed calico cat <<<2ab36fde-48a2-4f46-ba0c-0e3c66e86f84>>> crosses the frame and looks straight into the lens. In front of the couple, sharp and label to camera, the open bottle with its black screw cap beside it and two stemmed glasses of red wine, one a third full, one half full. The bottle is exactly <<<de0c221b-6bd9-4ab5-912b-c6840b2423cc>>>: dark glass Bordeaux bottle, black screw cap, bright yellow front label framed top and bottom by black-and-yellow diagonal caution stripes, four black zombie silhouettes in a row (three lurching zombies in profile with bent, raised arms in a staggering zombie walk and one crouched) plus a small black hand rising from the ground, the name in dark red gothic blackletter and the word RIOJA below it. Keep the label geometry, colours, stripes and silhouettes exactly as the reference; ignore the reference's white background. The cap is a screw cap, never a cork. CAMERA: 35 mm, f/2.8, eye level, from the entrance toward the table and window, warm pendant key, blue moonlight fill, magenta and cyan rims. no extra bottles, no cork, no candles, no readable captions or added text, no logos other than the label, no watermark, no neon signs with brand names, no extra fingers, no plastic skin, no faces or eyes on the zombie silhouettes, no purple lens flares.
